title: Velvety Blueberry Indian Blueberries Curry
description: A smoky, glassy-jelly Indian dish featuring blueberries, perfect for a brunch mood in the form of a tandoor-clay-pot stir-fry. This Jain-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Indian curries.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or vegan butter in a tandoor-clay-pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's lightly caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the blueberries, salt, and remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee or vegan butter and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the blueberries have broken down and the mixture has thickened, about 12 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan bread.
This dish can be made ahead and refrigerated for up to 24 hours or frozen for up to 2 months.
When reheating, add a splash of water if the mixture has thickened too much.
Adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
